summary: Group/Team Evaluation Mode (Fase A) — Backend 7/7 PASS, Frontend full happy-path PASS. Verified POST /api/plan-data/evaluations-export/group returns correct schema (group_size, with_data, team_avg, ranking[], aspects[], categories[], critical[]); ranking is sorted desc by global_pct with 'rank' field; critical only contains aspects with avg_pct<60; empty athlete_ids returns zeroed payload; invalid evaluation_type → 400; unauthenticated → 401/403. Frontend: after login as test@train.com, opened Plan Test API → Evaluación → Control Físico. Toggle Individual/Equipo works, group selector exposes 3 modes (team / category / national_team) plus eval-physical-group-select; selecting 'Selección Sub-17' renders KPI eval-physical-team-avg=52%, ranking with Juan Pérez (65% rank 1) and Carlos Pérez (40% rank 2), and a critical-areas card with Velocidad 35%. Switching back to Individual restores Guardar/Plantillas/PDF buttons.

issues: Header title in the screenshot still showed 'Control Médico — Estado de salud y aptitud...' even though the active subnav highlighted is 'Control Físico' and all data-testids resolve to eval-physical-*. Possibly a stale header from the previous Control Médico subtab not re-rendering when the subnav changes. Functional flow is not blocked, but visually inconsistent. Reproduce: navigate Datos → Evaluación → click Control Médico first, then click Control Físico; observe the title bar.

React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>.' — the native <select> currently wraps option labels in <span> with an icon. Cosmetic but creates noisy warnings; either move the icon out of <option> or render the select via a non-native (shadcn) component.

action_items: (low) Fix the EvaluationSection header to refresh title/subtitle when subnav switches between Control Médico/Físico/Técnico/... — likely a missing dependency in the useEffect that derives `config` from the route key, or the header is reading from a state that lags one render.
(low) Remove <span>/icon nesting inside <option> elements in EvaluationTeamMode's group-select to silence the React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/evaluations_export.py::group_evaluation — correctly validates evaluation_type against EVAL_META (400 for unknown), uses _norm_aspect_pct to clip pct to [0,100], sorts ranking by (has_data, global_pct) desc and assigns rank only to entries with data. team_avg averages only with-data entries → matches expected 52 for seed (65+40)/2.

EvaluationSection.js — toggle viewMode 'individual'/'team' renders <EvaluationTeamMode/> conditionally and hides the individual action bar (Guardar/Plantillas/PDF) which is correct; data-testids `eval-${evalType}-mode-toggle/individual/team` are exposed and stable.

EvaluationTeamMode.jsx — fetches /api/teams and /api/entities?entity_type=national_team in parallel on mount; correctly resolves athlete→team membership from team.athletes array (with fallback to athlete.team_id). Reset of selectedGroup on groupMode change is well handled.

Note: backend EVAL_META key is 'physical' but frontend URL/subnav uses 'control-physical' (mapped via SECTION_CONFIG type='physical'). Anyone writing direct API tests must use 'physical' for evaluation_type — this is a known mapping and is documented in EvaluationSection.js SECTION_CONFIG.
